title: Iran War Exposes Dangerous Gaps in US Military Medical Evacuation System
detail: Business Insider reports the Iran war has exposed dangerous gaps in the US military medical evacuation and trauma care system, which was originally built to treat wounded troops in Middle Eastern ground conflicts. Pentagon officials face mounting questions about readiness for casualties in a high-intensity conflict with Iran, including capacity constraints in the medevac pipeline and trauma surgery infrastructure.

title: Trump Declares Iran 'Failing Badly' as Yemen Conflict Widens
detail: US President Trump publicly declared Iran is 'failing badly' as conflict in Yemen continues to widen, signaling sustained US pressure on Tehran amid ongoing regional escalation involving Houthi forces. The statement underscores continued US alignment against Iranian-backed proxies in the region.
